articles.summary: BLACKSBURG, VA, NOVEMBER 12, 2026: The Board of Directors of National Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ Capital Market: NKSH ) today approved payment on December 1, 2026, of a semi-annual dividend of $0.78 per share to all stockholders of record as of November 23, 2026. President CEO Lara E. Ramsey commented, 2026 has been a good year for earnings, and we are pleased to share that success with our latest dividend payment. Our Company has proven once again that it can provide outstanding customer and community service while delivering solid shareholder value. About National Bankshares National Bankshares, Inc., headquartered in Blacksburg, Virginia, is the parent company of The National Bank of Blacksburg, which does business as National Bank, and of National Bankshares Financial Services, Inc. National Bank is a community bank operating from 28 full-service offices in Southwestern, Western and Central Virginia, and one loan production office in Charlottesville,
articles.title: National Bankshares, Inc. Declares Semi-Annual Dividend
